_readme: The ONE list of claims the public site must not make until the feature behind them exists. Phil confirmed on 2026-10-25 that none of these is built yet. scripts/test-unbuilt-claims.ts fails if any pattern matches page source (app, components, lib, public, data) or the built pages. When a feature ships, delete its entry here in the same change that puts the claim back; nothing else needs touching. Each entry: id (unique), feature (what has to exist first), pattern (a JavaScript regular expression, matched case-insensitively across line breaks, so use \s+ between words), example (a string the pattern must match, so a typo cannot silently turn a rule off).

claims.feature: Dispatch staffed around the clock. Until then use lib/confirmation-promise.ts (confirmed during business hours).
A photo sent to the owner at pickup.
Driver training in carrier handling (drivers have not completed training yet).
A signed owner liability waiver on every trip.
claims.example: a signed liability waiver on every trip

claims.feature: Staff checking vaccine records before a ride. Until then say: current rabies vaccination required, and the owner confirms rabies status when booking.
Working relationships with Charlotte clinics. Until then invite them to talk to us about a partner program.
claims.example: We work directly with clinics across Charlotte
